__schema0.description: The ID of the agent to chat with. Defaults to the default Elastic AI agent.

__schema11.description: When true, newly created conversations are public to users who can use the agent. Defaults to private. Ignored when continuing an existing conversation.

__schema13.description: When true, the run writes nothing to a conversation: no conversation is created and, with conversation_id, the conversation is loaded as context but not modified (no message, round, metadata or workspace change). Defaults to false.

__schema15.description: The feature id to attribute this step's LLM calls to for billing (connector telemetry pluginId).

__schema17.description: The product solution to attribute this step to. Ignored when `plugin-id` is not set.

__schema19.description: The product feature to attribute this step to. Ignored when `plugin-id` is not set.

__schema2.description: The ID of the connector to use. Defaults to the default GenAI connector. Mutually exclusive with `inference-id`.

__schema21.description: The parent feature id to group this step's LLM token usage under (connector telemetry aggregateBy).

__schema23.description: Maximum response size for this workflow step.

__schema25.description: [tech preview] Reasoning effort level forwarded to the LLM for this step's calls. Support depends on the underlying model and provider. Ignored when the step runs on a `connector-id-by-feature` feature, whose configured reasoning is used instead.

__schema4.description: The inference endpoint ID to use. Mutually exclusive with `connector-id`; defaults apply when both are omitted.

__schema6.description: A Model Management feature id, or an ordered list of them. The step runs on the first id that has a model configured for it: the feature's configured model and reasoning are used, and `reasoning-level` is ignored. An id that is not registered, or has no configured model, is skipped and the next id is tried. A configured feature is mutually exclusive with `connector-id` and `inference-id`. A list where every id misses is not a conflict.

__schema9.description: When true, creates a conversation for the step.

auto_approved_apis.description: Destructive APIs pre-approved for this step, keyed by backend, which the agent may then call without a user confirmation.

elasticsearch.description: Elasticsearch APIs pre-approved for this step. Each entry is an exact identifier formed from the namespace and name (e.g. "indices.create"), a namespace wildcard (e.g. "indices.*"), or "*" for every Elasticsearch API.

kibana.description: Kibana APIs pre-approved for this step. Each entry is an exact identifier formed from the namespace and name (e.g. "alerting.delete-alerting-rule-id"), a namespace wildcard (e.g. "alerting.*"), or "*" for every Kibana API.

enable_elastic_capabilities.description: Whether to enable built-in Elastic skills for this execution.

instructions.description: Custom instructions for the agent, replacing the stored instructions.

skill_ids.description: Skill IDs to enable for this execution, replacing the stored skill list. Note: only fully restricts the available skill set when enable_elastic_capabilities is also set to false.

tools.description: Tool selection to enable for this execution, replacing the stored tool list.

approvals.description: Actions pre-approved for this step, which the agent may then take without a user confirmation. The grant covers this step execution and the sub-agents it spawns, and adds to any defaults stored in the agent's configuration.

attachments.description: Optional attachments to provide to the agent.

author_name.description: Display name recorded on the user message this step writes, for example the workflow name. Applied only when the workflow runs as a service account; the message stays attributed to that account.

configuration_overrides.description: Runtime configuration overrides applied to this step execution only. Each provided field replaces the corresponding field in the stored agent configuration.

conversation_id.description: Optional existing conversation ID to continue a previous conversation.

message.description: The user input message to send to the agent.

metadata.description: Optional key-value tags stored with the underlying agent execution and searchable via findExecutions. Callers that need to discover the execution id before this step completes (e.g. to follow it live) can tag it with a value they already know and look it up by that tag.

schema.description: The schema for the output of the agent.

template_id.description: Pinned EIS prompt template id, including the leading dot. Sent instead of the message when the connector requires templates.

template_variables.description: Variables for template_id. Ignored when the connector does not require a template.

template_version.description: Pinned EIS prompt template version. Required with template_id when the connector requires templates.

cachedTokens.description: Cached input tokens reused across all LLM rounds. Subset of inputTokens.

connectorId.description: Id of the LLM connector used for this step, when reported by the model.

inputTokens.description: Total input tokens consumed across all LLM rounds.

outputTokens.description: Total output tokens produced across all LLM rounds.

totalTokens.description: Sum of input and output tokens across all LLM rounds.

conversation_id.description: Conversation ID associated with this step execution. Present when the step created or updated a conversation.

message.description: The text response from the agent. When schema is provided, contains a string version of the structured output

metadata.description: Step execution metadata, including token usage across all LLM rounds.

structured_output.description: The structured output from the agent. Only here when schema was provided
